notes.title: Horns of Justice beta (v0.8.0)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are excited to bring you the [b]Horns of Justice beta version[/b]. This version adds the final story chapters, a new playable character and many smaller improvements!

Bear in mind that this beta version is still in a prototype stage, much is not yet representative of the final product. 

Nevertheless we are curious to hear what you think! Now is the time to help us build the best game possible. Let us know your comments or feedback on our Discord.

We hope to see you on the sands of the arena!

[b]Horns of Justice beta (v0.8.0)[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Final chapters for the singleplayer mode[/b]: Reach the conclusion of the tournament. Will your actions be able to shape the future of Etanor?

[*] [b]A new playable character: [i]"Terrack, the artillerist"[/i][/b]: Play as everyone's favorite champion of Etanor in this patch. Use your artillery shells to rain death on your opponents from afar.

[*] [b]Improved sound effects, music and additional voice-overs.[/b]

[*] [b]Many, many small tweaks, improvements and bugfixes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Horns of Justice alpha release
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are excited to bring you the [b]Horns of Justice alpha version[/b]. This version contains a large update to the singleplayer campaign, a lobby system for multiplayer matches and many, many overall improvements.

Bear in mind that this still is an early version of the game, much is not yet representative of the final product. 

Nevertheless we are eager to hear what you think! Let us know your comments or feedback on our Discord or one of the other channels.

We hope to see you on the sands of the arena!

[b]Horns of Justice alpha (v0.7.0)[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Massive update for the singleplayer mode[/b]: additional story chapters, extra functionality, extra bits of story that help you to further explore the world of Horns of Justice.
[*] [b]A custom lobby system for the multiplayer[/b]: Play together more easily with your friends, create your own teams and fill up empty spots with bots.
[*] [b]Improved many of the in-game visuals[/b]: ability effects, targeting indicators, character portraits, turret animations and effects and much more.
[*] [b]Improved sound effects, music and additional voice-overs.[/b]
[*] [b]Many, many small tweaks, improvements and bugfixes.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Horns of Justice pre-alpha (v0.6.0)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just released a new version of the pre-alpha build. This build contains both some major and minor tweaks. The full change log is listed below. We'd love to hear your opinion about the changes. See you in the arena!

[b]Horns of Justice pre-alpha (v0.6.0)[/b]
[list]
[*] Significantly improved A.I. for singleplayer matches
[*] Made the gameplay much faster with increased movement speed, lower turret health, fewer turrets and the option to cast some abilities while moving
[*] Reworked the turret behaviors, making them more aggressive against attackers
[*] Tweaked the Scaab behavior, making it less punishing to carry the ball
[*] Made the practice scenarios randomized with different opponents and allies
[*] Added visual feedback for the experience and leveling mechanics
[*] Improved the HUD and scoreboard with more information about your allies and opponents
[*] Added a post-match results screen with statistics
[*] Many smaller balance tweaks
[/list]
